Cluster 2
selector .muted · 6 open issues

The .muted text color #9a9a9a reaches only 2.81:1 on white, below the 4.5:1 threshold.

Fix

From cluster-2, 3 of 3 groups; scope: new violations

Framework

react

Do this

Every member matches the single `.muted` rule, which paints `color: var(--muted-bad)`, so change that one token on `:root` in src/styles.css from `#9a9a9a` (2.81:1 on the `#ffffff` body and `.modal` background) to `#595959`, which gives 7.0:1 at 14.4px normal weight and clears the 4.5:1 threshold for both `#last-updated` in the footer and `#upload-hint` inside `#upload-dialog`. No markup changes are needed: `.muted` is the only declaration setting these colours, and `.hint` on `#upload-hint` contributes font-size only.

Edit

Verify

Re-run axe rules color-contrast against the 6 listed selectors; all must pass.

http://localhost:4173/status
Main content
Component: Main Content
Remediation

Add visible text, or aria-label="...", or a <span class="sr-only">...</span> inside the button.

Add visible text, or aria-label="...", or a <span class="sr-only">...</span> inside the button.

aria-expanded={open} in JSX — aria-* and data-* keep their hyphenated names; for becomes htmlFor and class becomes className.
Cluster 3
selector button.icon-btn · 3 open issues

The icon-btn pattern in Status.jsx renders icon-only buttons without any authored accessible name.

Fix

From cluster-3, 3 of 3 groups; scope: new violations

Framework

react

Do this

Both `.icon-btn` buttons in src/pages/Status.jsx wrap only an `aria-hidden="true"` inline SVG, so nothing contributes an accessible name; give each one an authored `aria-label` next to its existing `className="icon-btn"` — `aria-label="Refresh case list"` on `#refresh` (line 41) and `aria-label="Close upload dialog"` on `#upload-close` (line 18). Leave the SVGs `aria-hidden="true"` so the label is the only name, and drop the now-resolved `{/* DEBT button-name: icon-only refresh button */}` comment above the refresh button. Any future icon-only button using this class must carry the same `aria-label`, since the class itself can supply no name.

Edits

src/pages/Status.jsx:18

Replacement
          <button type="button" className="icon-btn" id="upload-close" aria-label="Close upload dialog" onClick={onClose}><svg aria-hidden="true" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14"><path d="M2 2l10 10M12 2L2 12" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2"/></svg></button>

src/pages/Status.jsx:40–41

Replacement
        <button type="button" className="icon-btn" id="refresh" aria-label="Refresh case list"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 18 18"><path d="M3 9a6 6 0 1 1 2 4.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2"/><path d="M3 14v-4h4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2"/></svg></button>
Verify

Re-run axe rules button-name against the 3 listed selectors; all must pass.

Cluster 3
selector button.icon-btn · 3 open issues

The icon-btn pattern in Status.jsx renders icon-only buttons without any authored accessible name.

Fix

From cluster-3, 3 of 3 groups; scope: new violations

Framework

react

Do this

Both `.icon-btn` buttons in src/pages/Status.jsx wrap only an `aria-hidden="true"` inline SVG, so nothing contributes an accessible name; give each one an authored `aria-label` next to its existing `className="icon-btn"` — `aria-label="Refresh case list"` on `#refresh` (line 41) and `aria-label="Close upload dialog"` on `#upload-close` (line 18). Leave the SVGs `aria-hidden="true"` so the label is the only name, and drop the now-resolved `{/* DEBT button-name: icon-only refresh button */}` comment above the refresh button. Any future icon-only button using this class must carry the same `aria-label`, since the class itself can supply no name.
